correctness.rationale: Reconstructed binary carry q*2^t=n+1 and the shared prefix replacement P0 1^t versus P1 0^t; for mixed length-three patterns all internal constant-suffix triples are absent, so the change indicator depends on odd q mod 8 and truncated v2(n+1) (with sparse q=1,3 exceptions). The bundled verify.py explicitly generates local transition table from occurrence parity rather than hardcoding it, checks q equivalences and exceptional stable suffix, enumerates 64 phase classes with at most one divisible-by-16 position in 14 consecutive transitions, enumerates all permitted odd residues and exact rational density weights, then checks first 145 symbols. The finite reduction is mathematically justified by carry locality and 2-adic residue densities; a prefix alone would not prove exhaustion. Independently recomputed 131072 symbols for each of the six words, recovered full spectra and rational frequency agreement. Origin-only runs and density 0 are handled separately. The length-weighted densities equal 1.
